from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
programs=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545201/attempts/077c639e3ede471faa305f8b7291dc1f/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    frames = []
    for r0 in range(h - 2):
        for r1 in range(r0 + 2, h):
            for c0 in range(w - 2):
                for c1 in range(c0 + 2, w):
                    color = grid[r0][c0]
                    if color == background:
                        continue
                    if (all(grid[r0][c] == color and grid[r1][c] == color for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)) and
                        all(grid[r][c0] == color and grid[r][c1] == color for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)) and
                        all(grid[r][c] == background for r in range(r0 + 1, r1) for c in range(c0 + 1, c1))):
                        frames.append((r0, r1, c0, c1))
    for r0, r1, c0, c1 in frames:
        area = (r1 - r0 - 1) * (c1 - c0 - 1)
        fill = 2 if area % 2 == 0 else 7
        for r in range(r0 + 1, r1):
            for c in range(c0 + 1, c1):
                out[r][c] = fill
    return out
'''
path=programs/'task-e480fa9e.py'
path.write_text(code)
print(path)
